title: The file preview
purpose: The kit's file viewer (FileViewer of pi-app, with the default kinds of pi-app-kinds) alone on a neutral page over a fake in-memory resource client with invented French files: a Markdown note, a CSV of gaps and a text file. The two buttons that open a file and the surface are the consumer's own.

fixture.usage: <FileViewer key={path} path={path} locator={locate(path)} options={{ client, identity, kinds: defaultKinds({ locale: 'fr' }) }} onClose={() => setPath(null)} />

notes: The viewer's bar keeps the file's name and a close button in reach (44 px on a phone); the content is the file as the person wrote it (a note reads as a note, a table as a table (FileViewer shows a CSV as plain text; the table is the ArtifactPanel kind, state 03b)); closing returns to the page the person came from; French words stay as they are.

steps.expect: The note opens in the viewer with its title and its text.
The viewer closes and the list of files is back.

steps.gap: FileViewer takes no keyboard shortcut: Escape does nothing in the kit (a host must listen for it and call its own onClose).
The kit has no next / previous in FileViewer: only onBack (a back button to the host's list) and onClose. The host would draw its own arrows and remount with a new path.
steps.expect: The next file of the folder is shown.
